purpose: separate structural fair comparison from low-fidelity teacher selection so that one task cannot silently change the other
supersedes_only: single representative point as a cross-model winner
using teacher-selection preference to redefine the fair-comparison Pareto result
using amplitude DMA in calibration or teacher selection

common_immutable_definitions.equilibrium_network: one fixed Zhang--Li long-term equilibrium network
common_immutable_definitions.relaxation_loading: prescribed constant-rate loading ramps; no ideal-step replacement
common_immutable_definitions.amplitude_DMA_role: external diagnostic only; excluded from calibration, early stopping, fair representative choice and teacher selection

layer_A_fair_comparison.question: What capability and boundary is attainable by each progressively enriched traditional structure under common data, physics, solvers and metrics?
layer_A_fair_comparison.output: a Pareto- and evidence-based comparison, not a single overall champion

frequency_loss.strict_solver: full-cycle periodic integration at 128 points per cycle after transient removal

evidence_hierarchy: training L_time--L_frequency Pareto relation under the frozen discovery campaign
q, R_neq, total relaxation, stress, G_prime and G_double_prime decomposed metrics
parameter stability, identifiability and computational cost

pareto_rules.dominance_definition: no worse on both axes and strictly better on at least one axis
pareto_rules.cross_model_claim: report crossing, local dominance and bounded structural gains; do not infer a universal winner from one scalarization

representative_snapshot_rules.role: one reproducible parameter snapshot for curve panels and decomposed tables
representative_snapshot_rules.T0: reuse the qualified saturated T0 snapshot without rerunning
representative_snapshot_rules.T1_T2: use guarded active snapshots; old guarded baselines are forced into strict evaluation and replacement requires time and frequency nondegradation
representative_snapshot_rules.required_label_in_reports: guarded illustrative snapshot; structural conclusions rely on the full evidence hierarchy

optimization_comparability.discovery_campaign: dimension-scaled candidate budgets and common scalarization grid from chapter2_fair_comparison_protocol.json
optimization_comparability.T0_action: not rerun because the frozen discovery campaign already passed its saturation gate
optimization_comparability.T1_T2_guarded_campaign: reported separately as baseline recovery and local refinement; it cannot be counted as an equal-budget Pareto advantage over T0
optimization_comparability.claim_boundary: best reproducibly attained result under the documented cumulative searches, not a proof of global optimum

forbidden_conclusions: the model with the lowest single joint score is universally best
a lower total stress RMSE proves a better nonequilibrium law
teacher selection proves structural Pareto dominance
all traditional viscoelastic models are unable to achieve time-frequency consistency

layer_B_teacher_selection.question: Which audited model is the most suitable physically acceptable low-fidelity source of complete constitutive-state labels?
layer_B_teacher_selection.timing: performed only after Layer A model structures, active snapshots and validation evidence are frozen
layer_B_teacher_selection.structural_eligibility_note: T0 remains a valid fair-comparison baseline but is ineligible for the complete-state teacher role unless a branchwise tensor state and dissipation definition is added, which would constitute a new model.

data_use.training_data: used for calibration and teacher scoring
data_use.held_out_data: excluded from calibration; allowed in teacher scoring only after all candidate structures and parameters are frozen
data_use.amplitude_DMA: external confidence-domain diagnosis only; excluded from teacher identity score

predictive_utility.rationale: complete-state pretraining prioritizes q and R_neq label fidelity while retaining nonzero time- and frequency-domain evidence

secondary_penalties.cost: S_cost=min(log(1+C_model/C_T0)/log(101),1), using accumulated candidate CPU seconds and the frozen T0 cost

decision_rule.step_1: remove every candidate failing any eligibility gate
decision_rule.step_2: compute the frozen predictive utility and secondary penalties without model-specific renormalization
decision_rule.no_eligible_candidate: do not create a formal teacher; report that only baseline models are available

layer_B_teacher_selection.decision_status: pending final active-parameter numerical validation, seed-stability recomputation and cost synchronization; no model name is frozen by this protocol

requires_new_schema_version: model structure, branch count, time scales or equilibrium network
Layer A metric weights or Pareto rules
Layer B eligibility gates, score weights, scales or tie breakers
